items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: He said, well, Kepeda, as you're going home, he says, here's one of the pictures. So he gave me that one.

ctx.x: What about a drummer in Chicago? You didn't use any drummer then?

No. Well, no, I'll tell you. When we got to Chicago, they suggested that they wasn't going to use no drummer. You know? Yeah. They used a fat fella for a while, but they put him off. And they say he was too loud or something. He wasn't from here. He's not from here. When we got over there, we seen him, but he was from over there. So the manager suggested that we would make it without that. So we just used our six pieces. Yeah. And while she was dancing and singing and making them designs, you know, making them…
Yeah, yeah, just an Egyptian piece, Egyptian rag.
